explanation: The router stores one study selection per report kind (geneStudySelection, pathwayStudySelection) and reads and writes links through selectionFromLink / selectionLink, imported from studySelectionLink.ts so the entry bundle never reaches the derivation hook or the evidence ledgers it pulls in; the gene-only reportScope and setReportScope are gone, so boot and Back/Forward now read a link's categories by the same rule. App drops its six scope adapters and keys the gene report boundary on the term alone, as the pathway report already was.
